candidates.title: Desktop Pet Interactive Control Demo Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive quick-command checklist on the final screen teaching users how to summon, interact with, and hide their desktop pet.
candidates.why: Addresses top support post-onboarding confusion (3 emails) where users don't know how to control or hide their pet after setup.

components.text: Try controls: Right-click pet to hide/show; Press Alt+P to open quick menu.

guard.reason: Adds interactive control checklist to home_intro without violating onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Interactive demo targets 35.2% drop-off on finish and 3 support emails, but requires new flow work.

candidates.title: Reorder Sign In After Adoption Flow
candidates.change: Moves account sign-in after pet adoption certificate creation so users experience pet creation before registering.
candidates.why: Capitalizes on adoption completion momentum and reduces initial friction where drop-off occurs early.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in after adoption certificate creation is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in after adoption leverages completion momentum but alters core flow structure.

candidates.title: Story Screen Split Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the intro story screen into a split layout showcasing animated desktop pet previews side-by-side with benefit callouts.
candidates.why: Initial path selection has a 76.2% conversion rate; stronger visual engagement on story increases onboarding momentum.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Choose a pre-made friend or create a custom pet to wander on your screen.

guard.reason: Redesigns story screen into a split layout while maintaining its core job of introducing pets.

candidates.score_note: Split layout redesign improves initial engagement where drop-off is 23.8%.

candidates.title: Interactive Pet Trait Selection Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a new pet personality screen before adoption certificate generation allowing users to pick companion behavioral traits.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.6%; adding personalized trait selection increases emotional ownership.

new_pet_personality.headline: Pick Your Pet's Personality
new_pet_personality.body: Choose how active, playful, or sleepy your companion should be on desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a new trait selection screen within the onboarding flow is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Adds trait selection screen to boost adoption ownership, but adds step length.

candidates.title: Pet Mascot Welcome Incentive Banner
candidates.change: Displays a prominent mascot badge on the choose path screen highlighting exclusive free accessory unlocks upon completing onboarding.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion rate is low at 21.4%; incentivizing completion early increases retention.

components.text: Unlock Exclusive Starter Accessories Upon Setup

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions unlocking exclusive starter accessories (free extras/gifts).

candidates.title: Photo Upload Tip Carousel Component
candidates.change: Replaces static photo upload section with an interactive tip carousel explaining lighting and photo clarity requirements for custom pets.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results during adoption.

photo_upload.text: Upload clear, well-lit photos from the front for ideal custom pet rendering.

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[0]': a tip_carousel cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Progress Audio Visualizer
candidates.change: Adds an interactive audio feedback button and progress status bar while waiting for pet desktop assets to render.
candidates.why: Median waiting screen time is 201s (mean 2336s), creating drop-off without clear progress indicators.

guard.reason: Adds audio preview to waiting screen while retaining pet creation progress indicators.

candidates.score_note: Directly mitigates high 201s median / 2336s mean waiting screen drop-off.

candidates.title: Final Screen Control Shortcuts Card
candidates.change: Updates the final welcome screen body copy with clear desktop control shortcuts and right-click interaction instructions.
candidates.why: Addresses post-onboarding user feedback (3 emails) regarding difficulty finding control and hide commands.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Pet is Ready!
home_intro.body: Press Alt+P anytime to adjust settings, or right-click your pet on the screen to hide or summon them.

guard.reason: Updates home_intro copy with control shortcuts without altering external features or rules.

candidates.score_note: Simple copy change addressing 3 support emails on finish screen controls.

candidates.title: Account Sync Safeguard Notification Banner
candidates.change: Adds a notification hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that existing pets and progress will be securely linked to their account.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (largest theme) reported missing or reset pets after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in automatically saves and links your created desktop pets to your account.

guard.reason: Adds informative account sync hint on sign_in screen without requesting new personal data.

candidates.score_note: Addresses the largest support issue theme (8 emails) regarding lost pet account sync.

candidates.title: Interactive Adoption Certificate Screen Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the adoption certificate screen into a full-bleed celebratory card featuring a playful sound preview component.
candidates.why: Improves step conversion on adoption (currently 69.6%) by turning pet creation confirmation into a highly rewarding milestone.

guard.reason: Redesigns adoption certificate layout and adds audio component while preserving screen job.

candidates.score_note: Full-bleed redesign with audio feedback improves 69.6% adoption milestone conversion.
